summary: routes.md / routes.json pass the mechanical checks. All 147 IDs appear exactly once: 123 designed and 24 excluded, with no route, link or nav item for any excluded ID. The App Router tree has 0 dynamic slug-name conflicts and 26 intermediates, which match the redirect table. Every pageRoutePattern is in the tree, and the tree text in the .md and .json is identical. The workspace bases and the sidebar order match navigation.json. The sidebar active-item map matches the aria-current of every B2-B7 product frame. Of the 20 sampled departures, 19 hold against the boards. The exception is D-28/O-11 (correction 2), which reads board-level hrefs wrongly. Nine of the 12 corrections are substantive. 1) The PU-10/PU-12 session gate blocks the drawn Institute Admin entries (B3-08). 2) D-28/O-11 reverses the B7-01 instruction that each row opens the page where it is handled. 3) ST-16 'Not eligible', and the CONFIRMED guard that relies on it, is attributed wrongly: B3-06 f5 is drawn as the ST-09 VR page. 4) VE-05 lists a canvas sample-pool behaviour as a product state. 5) The record-guard row is marked CONFIRMED although D-27/O-07 is UNRESOLVED, and the 'View earlier work' link has no interim target. The rest are status and count wording, default-tab URLs, state attribution, register-board citations, disposition wording, returnTo validation, the IA-01 report link, and the unknown-id behaviour of the record guard.

checksRun.check: (a) 147 IDs exactly once; 123 designed with route; 24 excluded with screens.json disposition
checksRun.detail: python3 -I check_a.py: 147 rows, 147 unique, 0 duplicates, 0 missing, 0 extra. designed=123, excluded=24 (the expected set). designed, proposedRoute, inventoryDisposition, surface, screen and type all equal screens.json. Status counts: CONFIRMED 108, board-forced 7, PROPOSED 8, EXCLUDED 24. Disposition text is paraphrased for 2 IDs. ST-20 drops '— public catalogue stays reachable from the footer'. PU-16 replaces 'no fake pages' with 'footer has real links only'. See correction 10.

checksRun.check: (b) no two designed routes share a URL unless deliberate
checksRun.detail: Shared URLs are all deliberate tab, state or step sharing, and each is stated in its row: ST-02/ST-04; IA-02/IA-16; IA-06/08/13/15; IA-17/IA-18; PU-10/PU-13; XS-01/03/04; ST-16/ST-17; ST-05/ST-19; RV-03/RV-06; CM-06/07/08 detail; VE-03…06/VE-09 (/edit). Two URLs exist for one default-tab view: IA-06 '/institute/people?tab=students' with bare '/institute/people', and SA-16 '?tab=vendors (default)'. Both contradict rules T2/T3 (default tab carries no parameter). See correction 7.

checksRun.check: (c) App Router tree: slug conflicts, catch-all ambiguity, every table route present in the tree
checksRun.detail: check_c.py over the 123 pageRoutePatterns found 0 dynamic slug-name conflicts. The static+dynamic siblings are exactly the 5 that the plan declares (simulation/web vs [format]; assessments/new; question-bank/new|draft|import; requests/devices vs [requestId], redirected; vendor experiments/new). There are 26 intermediates, equal to the redirect table: rows 1-19, plus 7 /help/reports. Every path in a row's recommendedRoute is in pageRoutePatterns; the only non-route values are PU-15 file names and the /signed-out alias. All patterns appear in the tree. The tree text in routes.md and routes.json is identical. Each [...unmatched] catch-all sits only beside static siblings, so it cannot shadow a page. One inconsistency: the tree note says the experiment record guard 'never calls notFound()', but runtime guard 14 says an unknown record id gives notFound(). See correction 12.
